findings.description: When to_timestamp fails, the code rejects the request with requeue=False, but the early `return` was removed. Execution then continues with eta still None, so the function reaches task_reserved(req), the callbacks and handle(req). A task the broker has just rejected is therefore still queued for execution. This happens on every message whose ETA cannot be converted, such as an out-of-range timestamp.
findings.title: Rejected task is still dispatched after the ETA conversion failure

findings.description: The removed mark_as_failure call was the only place that stored the conversion error on the result backend. Without it, a task that fails ETA conversion is rejected silently, and clients polling its result never see a FAILURE state with the exception.
findings.suggestion: Restore the mark_as_failure call before the reject, or otherwise record the failure on the result backend.
findings.title: Failure result is no longer recorded for the task
